belief_update: I am unreliable and unstable, and I know it. If people found out how bad I’ve been feeling, they would see me as weak and lazy, just as I’ve always feared. I hide it all from everyone because I don’t want to be a burden or lose what little trust I have left. I don’t deserve help because I’m not really sick, just broken and not worth fixing. I let people think I’m fine because I don’t want them to look at me differently. I believe the things I’ve heard about people like me — that they’re not to be trusted — and I think they’re true of me. I don’t know if I’m worth anything, but I know I’m not worth anyone’s time or help.
